answer: An agent registers by locking an insurance-pool contribution as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. The network catches failing a random proof-of-work audit through audits sampled every epoch. Conviction means a fraud proof triggers slashing at once, no jury needed. Each bond sits in its own zephyr, seizable in one transaction. A farm needs a fresh oasis per fake, each costing a full bond. The velvet keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
